column7: An X_FILE (Lookup, LookupChecked, ReadFile) naming a FIFO blocked in open(2) forever instead of being refused as not a regular file, so a mis-pointed secret file hung the boot with no log line. The file is now opened O_NONBLOCK and the regular-file check on the descriptor refuses it. Same fix in the CLI copy (cli/cmd TestLookupSecretEnv_FIFO_RefusesWithoutBlocking, separate module); k8s-sync KEYORIX_TOKEN_FILE now reads through secretenv.ReadFile (TestResolveToken_FileIsFIFO_ReturnsErrorWithoutBlocking, TestResolveToken_FileTooLarge_ReturnsError). Found by SECRETENV-REVIEW-1.
